title: Why Trump Waged War On Iran
description:

The Ayatollah is dead, Iran’s command structure has been rocked, and the media is already panicking. Is this endless war—or strategic deterrence?

comments.text:
24:30 I'm not trying to be that guy, but a dirty bomb doesn't use uranium. it uses cobalt-60 or Cesium-137. It's not at all similar to nukes; the main purpose is to scatter gamma-emitting isotopes into the environment. Contrary to popular belief, the radioactive isotope of uranium (Uranium-235) is fairly safe to be around. 

The main difference between a nuke and a dirty bomb is the main threat/function they serve. A nuke uses a radioactive isotope to create immense amounts of kinetic energy through fission. A dirty bomb is literally just a dangerous radioactive substance that is blown up through traditional means to scatter the substance and make a region uninhabitable. And yes, Iran, as well as any other developed nation, can create a dirty bomb since these same dangerous isotopes have tons of uses in the medical field.
